name: Amplitude
description: Query Amplitude analytics, charts, dashboards and experiments through Amplitude's hosted MCP server.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for Amplitude's US-hosted MCP server (the default region).
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in with an Amplitude account. The connection can read and change only the projects that account can access, so use an account scoped to what agents should see.
methods.label: Sign in with Amplitude (US)

methods.whenToUse: Use this only when your Amplitude data resides in the EU region.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in with an Amplitude account in the EU data region. The connection can read and change only the projects that account can access.
methods.label: Sign in with Amplitude (EU)
